payload.purpose_context: Today doctor doctrine only reads each consumer's hand-copied replaceable-builtins allowlist. Every time upstream promotes an org-authored artifact into the built-in set, consumers whose copy predates the promotion fail closed with no change on their side. This mission lets the org pack deliver its own scoped, reason-bearing sanction while keeping unsanctioned overrides fail-closed (issue #5767).
payload.purpose_tldr: Let org packs ship the sanction for the built-ins they deliberately replace, so consumers stop going red whenever an org artifact is promoted to built-in.

options: a: pack-root replaceable-builtins.yaml read in place
payload.question: Where does an org pack deliver its built-in override sanction: (a) pack-declared list unioned by doctor, (b) doctrine fetch installs into the consumer file, (c) per-node replaces: marker?

payload.final_answer: a: pack-root replaceable-builtins.yaml read in place

options: yes: additive revoked_pack_sanctions key in consumer file
payload.question: Must the consumer be able to revoke a pack-delivered sanction in this mission?

payload.final_answer: yes: additive revoked_pack_sanctions key in consumer file
